title: Injury report, Round 7: Montero doubtful; Fournier, Williams-Goss out

teams.label: Zalgiris
teams.summary: Nigel Williams-Goss is ruled out for Zalgiris's game against ASVEL on Friday, according to coach Tomas Masiulis.

teams.label: ASVEL
teams.summary: ASVEL has not yet sent an injury report for its game at Zalgiris on Friday.

teams.label: Olympiacos
teams.summary: Jean Montero is doubtful while Evan Fournier and Tyler Dorsey are ruled out for Olympiacos's game against Fenerbahce on Friday, the club has confirmed.

teams.label: Fenerbahce
teams.summary: Coach Saras Jasikevicius has his full roster available for Fenerbahce's game at Olympiacos on Friday, the club has confirmed.

teams.label: Paris
teams.summary: Paris has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Valencia on Friday.

teams.label: Valencia
teams.summary: Valencia has not yet sent an injury report for its game at Paris on Friday.

players.name: Nigel Williams-Goss
players.note: Nigel Williams-Goss returned to action in Round 6.

players.name: Patty Mills
players.note: Patty Mills did not play in Round 6.

players.name: Tremont Waters
players.note: Tremont Waters did not play in Round 6.

players.name: Juhann Begarin
players.note: Juhann Begarin, who joined ASVEL on a short-term deal on October 7, has not yet played for the team in the EuroLeague.

players.name: Edwin Jackson
players.note: Edwin Jackson made his first EuroLeague appearance of the season in Round 7.

players.name: Mathis Dossou-Yovo
players.note: Mathis Dossou-Yovo (groin) has been sidelined to start this season.

players.name: Tyler Dorsey
players.note: Tyler Dorsey was not available in Round 6.

players.name: Nadir Hifi
players.note: Nadir Hifi missed Rounds 5 and 6 last week due to an ankle injury. He also didn't play in the French League this past weekend.

players.name: TJ Warren
players.note: TJ Warren did not play in Round 6.

players.name: Frank Ntilikina
players.note: Frank Ntilikina last played in Round 2 and has been out ever since with muscle pain.
